raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "ensaio" %}
{% set version = "0.7.1" %}
{% set python_min = "3.9" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/ensaio-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 93ddaf030ba51798c02f61338093d2f589cd3f229827c8ff6c0d663f3722acfa

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools >=61
    - setuptools_scm >=6.2
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - pooch >=1.5.0,<2.0.0

test:
  imports:
    - ensaio
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/fatiando/ensaio
  summary: Practice datasets to probe your code
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - leouieda
